question: Should this PR receive a proof override for its production-function harness with a stubbed LINE SDK, or must the contributor provide redacted live LINE gateway evidence before merge?
rationale: The code change and focused validation are convincing, but repository policy treats external-PR real behavior proof as a merge gate and the submitted evidence explicitly stops before the live provider boundary.

options.title: Require live LINE proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted gateway transcript or logs showing real inbound profile resolution after the patch, with private identifiers and credentials removed.

options.title: Approve proof override
options.body: Accept the standalone production-path harness because the changed invariant is entirely local Map eviction and the external SDK response is not modified.

recommendation.title: Require live LINE proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted gateway transcript or logs showing real inbound profile resolution after the patch, with private identifiers and credentials removed.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history shows the strongest recent ownership signal for LINE send behavior and plugin-runtime boundaries.
